Subject: Demo + Go-live planning call for BadgeCo - scheduling

Hi Carlos —

Thanks again for the time last week. As discussed, we'd like to schedule the technical demo (AE + SE) and a follow-up go-live/rollout planning call that includes your engineering, procurement, and security teams. The goal of the planning call is to align on the cutover window, fallback policies, owners & runbooks, and any procurement/contract steps so the rollout is smooth.

Proposed schedule:
- Technical demo (45 min): week of Mar 1–5, options below
- Go-live / rollout planning (60 min): the week immediately after sign-off — tentative Mar 9 or Mar 10

My availability (PST):
- Mon Mar 1: 10:00–12:00
- Wed Mar 3: 09:00–11:30, 14:00–16:00
- Thu Mar 4: 13:00–17:00

Dylan (SE) is cc'd for technical availability and to confirm the draft rollout checklist. Stephanie (security) is cc'd to make sure we capture any pre-go-live security evidence. Laura (my manager) is looped in for procurement/discount approvals as needed.

I've attached our rollout playbook and a draft MOA to help frame the planning call. Please confirm who from BadgeCo should be on the planning call (eng, procurement contact, security owner) and which days/times work best.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0147

Hi Carlos / team —

Thanks — Thu Mar 4 at 14:00 PST works for me for the demo. I can take the first 30–40 minutes to walk through architecture, expected latency/cost tradeoffs for your expected traffic, and then reserve 10–15 minutes for Q&A and next steps.

For the go-live / rollout planning call, here's a suggested agenda so procurement/sec can see the scope: 
- Introductions & objectives (5)
- Cutover window and success criteria (15)
- Fallback policies & rollback plan (15)
- Owners & runbook handoff (10)
- SSO, network, and data residency checklist (10)
- Procurement & signing timeline (5)

Pre-reads: I attached the rollout playbook (same as Marissa) and an internal checklist. Ivan — if you can share any network/VPN requirements ahead of the planning call that would be helpful.

Notes for the planning call: we typically recommend a 1–2 hour maintenance window for the first cutover with a validated rollback path (old traffic routing + model variant fallback). We can present a fallback matrix during the call.

Cheers,
